next.reason: 1985: 'A RECEIVE statement that specifies a NO DATA or WITH DATA phrase.'; 2023: '2023 RECEIVE (14.9.31.4) has only ON EXCEPTION / NOT ON EXCEPTION and CONTINUE phrases; no NO DATA or WITH DATA phrase'. The 1985 communication RECEIVE with NO DATA/WITH DATA is gone. The 2023 RECEIVE is an MCS statement with exception phrases only, so this conditional-statement case has no counterpart.
